primary_source_check.status: Primary dataset landing independently inspected; follow-up ScienceDirectpaper request403; no exact study-to-all-curves linkage inferred.

reliability.rationale: Selected calibrated cap improves both reserved beams versus elastic/flexible controls:5.28109kN versus14.7367/8.73499. The common cap is better at4.75397, so material-specific superiority is falsified rather than silently promoted.

mechanism.rationale: A saturation cap regularizes load extrapolation; it does not isolate connector slip, timber damage, concrete cracking or their sequence. Concrete coefficient from four training beams is not a material constant.

novelty.rationale: Targeted primary-source context and established equation families do not establish global novelty. No independent expert/literature adjudication performed.

significance.rationale: Demonstrates the practical importance of a strong saturation control for later calibrated response. No structural acceptance/design resistance or virgin-material strength predictor follows.

reproducibility.rationale: Native parser, equations, frozen coefficients, predictions and grouping contracts are explicit and inspected. Full independent executable testing belongs to the separate computational review.

impact.rationale: No intervention, deployed savings, reliability qualification or independent experiment demonstrates industrial impact.
